o: a catalogue of separable app services
why: You can adopt one product and ignore the rest.

q: Which Firebase products carry high lock-in?
why: They become your data and identity layer.

q: Sending push through FCM requires the paid Blaze plan.
why: Myth. FCM is free and works on the no-cost Spark plan (verify current pricing).

q: The rule of thumb 'adopt the leaf, doubt the roots' means …
o: use push, but think hard before using Firebase's database and login
why: Push is easy to swap out; data and login are not.
